scripts.build: bun run scripts/build.js && bun run bundle-counter
scripts.check: bun run audit && bun fmt --check --ignore-unknown package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.js.json counter scripts tests && bun lint scripts site tests && bun --check --project=tsconfig.json && bun --check --project=tsconfig.js.json
